SPECTATE

Watch the lap. Learn the decision.

Watch a saved run

Use SPECTATE to follow recorded rivals. NEXT changes the run you follow; STOP returns from spectating. The drive pad and steering display replay the recorded controls when the lap has them.

Look for one thing

Watch a braking point, the end of a slide or where BOOST begins. Then try that one change in your own lap.

Read the setup

A replay can show the perks that run used. Understand the combination before expecting another car to follow the same line at the same speed.
